Alyssa —

We missed you on the call this morning; the meeting showed as started but the executive slot did not join. Hope everything is OK on your end.

Quick recap so you have context before we reschedule:
- Redwood is a developer-first inference platform (hosted / dedicated / private) focused on production SLAs, cost controls (batching/quantization), and predictable latency for interactive apps.
- Typical outcomes: 30-50% per-token cost reduction on write-heavy assistants, single-digit-ms improvements in tail latency via optimized serving runtime, and simple rollouts for model versioning.
- Security: VPC private control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs.

Next steps: would you be available to resync next week? I can share a short mutual action plan and bring our Solutions Engineering lead to cover SSO/procurement items.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 9/14 10:00–10:30 (tentative)
- Wed 9/15 11:00–11:30
- Thu 9/16 08:30–09:00

If none of these work, drop a few windows or use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/30min

Thanks —
Rishi
